name: CELPIP General
sections: Practise identifying speaker intent, details and changes in opinion.
Interpret correspondence, information and different viewpoints.
Skim for structure, then use evidence from the passage.
Write emails and respond to survey questions.
Plan your answer, organize paragraphs and proofread.
Respond to eight speaking tasks about everyday situations.
Answer directly, support your ideas and practise with a timer.
scoring: CELPIP reports individual skill levels. Confirm the required scores with the organization or immigration program you are applying to.

name: IELTS
description: English proficiency preparation for academic, professional and migration goals.
sections: Preview questions and watch for paraphrasing.
Interpret passages and answer comprehension questions.
Manage time and locate supporting evidence.
Follow the requirements of your selected IELTS test version.
Participate in a structured speaking interview.
scoring: IELTS uses band scores. Academic and General Training differ in some tasks.

name: PTE Academic
sections: Complete integrated speaking and writing tasks.
Practise clear speech and structured written answers.
Pay attention to meaning, grammar and time limits.
Understand recordings and complete listening tasks.
Take concise notes and practise active listening.
scoring: PTE Academic reports scores on a 10–90 scale. Check the official guide for current scoring details.

name: GRE General Test
sections: Analyze written material and vocabulary in context.
Solve mathematical and data interpretation problems.
Create a clear thesis and support it with examples.
scoring: GRE uses section-specific scoring. Verify current structure and score ranges with ETS.

name: GMAT Exam
sections: Interpret and evaluate information from different sources.
scoring: The current GMAT Exam uses a total score scale of 205–805. Verify current details with mba.com.
